metadata.description: Partial audit checklist for remaining properties (Run 1 of iterative generation)

checklist.title: Verify STATE-USER-IDLE cannot autonomously transition to privileged operations
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Identify all outgoing edges from STATE-USER-IDLE in the program graph
2. Verify each transition requires explicit user action (wallet signature)
3. Check that no background processes can initiate transitions
4. Confirm no oracle or keeper mechanisms can trigger state changes
5. Verify no time-based automatic transitions exist

executable_checks.command: Review user-initiated functions for signature requirements
executable_checks.assertion: All wrap/transfer/bridge operations require EOA transaction
No automated trigger mechanisms for user operations

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-STATE-USER-IDLE -> Node STATE-USER-IDLE. Entry point for private transfer initiation. All outgoing edges require explicit user action (cryptographic signing).

checklist.title: Verify STATE-USER-HAS-UNDERLYING accurately reflects on-chain ERC20 balance
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Locate LiquidityManager.wrap() function
2. Verify safeTransferFrom is used (not transferFrom)
3. Confirm balance check is implicit via transfer revert
4. Check no pre-balance caching that could be stale
5. Verify ERC20 interface compliance of underlying token interactions

executable_checks.assertion: safeTransferFrom used for underlying token pull
Wrap reverts when user lacks underlying balance

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-STATE-USER-HAS-UNDERLYING -> Node STATE-USER-HAS-UNDERLYING. Precondition for wrap operations. ERC20 standard enforcement via safeTransferFrom.

checklist.title: Verify STATE-USER-HAS-ZERC20 is only reachable through valid wrap or teleport paths
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Enumerate all paths to STATE-USER-HAS-ZERC20 in program graph
2. Verify wrap path requires prior underlying deposit
3. Verify teleport path requires valid Groth16 proof
4. Check for any administrative mint functions
5. Ensure no backdoor paths exist to mint without collateral or proof

executable_checks.assertion: Mint restricted to authorized callers only

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-STATE-USER-HAS-ZERC20 -> Node STATE-USER-HAS-ZERC20. Critical invariant for token supply integrity. Groth16 zkSNARK for teleport path.

checklist.title: Verify STATE-LM-AWAITING-WRAP validates wrap request parameters
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Locate wrap() function entry point
2. Verify amount > 0 check exists
3. Confirm msg.sender is implicitly non-zero (Solidity invariant)
4. Check for any additional parameter validation requirements
5. Verify validation happens before any state changes
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-STATE-LM-AWAITING-WRAP -> Node STATE-LM-AWAITING-WRAP. Input validation at trust boundary.

checklist.title: Verify ACTION-LM-CALCULATE-REWARD uses floor rounding preventing reward inflation
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Locate IncentiveLib reward calculation function
2. Verify floor rounding is used (not ceiling)
3. Check immutability of incentive parameters (k, T)
4. Verify calculation is deterministic (pure function)
5. Test edge cases around curve boundaries

executable_checks.command: Verify rounding direction in reward computation
executable_checks.assertion: Floor rounding used - protocol never overpays

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-ACTION-LM-CALCULATE-REWARD -> Node ACTION-LM-CALCULATE-REWARD. Economic security property - floor rounding prevents reward inflation.

checklist.title: Verify ACTION-LM-PULL-LIQUIDITY executes before any minting occurs
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Trace control flow in wrap() function
2. Verify safeTransferFrom call precedes _mint call
3. Confirm no code paths allow mint before transfer
4. Check for any reentrancy vectors between operations
5. Verify revert on transfer failure prevents any minting

executable_checks.assertion: Transfer occurs before mint in all code paths
No reentrancy between transfer and mint

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-ACTION-LM-PULL-LIQUIDITY -> Node ACTION-LM-PULL-LIQUIDITY. Prevents inflation attacks by ensuring collateral before minting.

checklist.title: Verify ACTION-LM-MINT-ZERC20 has exclusive minting authority via access control
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Locate mint function in zERC20 contract
2. Verify onlyMinter or equivalent modifier exists
3. Confirm LiquidityManager is the only registered minter
4. Check for any owner/admin override capabilities
5. Verify minter cannot be changed after deployment

executable_checks.assertion: No minter change function exists (or is properly protected)

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-ACTION-LM-MINT-ZERC20 -> Node ACTION-LM-MINT-ZERC20. Access control invariant for exclusive minting authority.

checklist.title: Verify STATE-WRAP-COMPLETE requires atomic execution of transfer and mint
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Verify wrap() is a single transaction
2. Confirm no intermediate state persistence between operations
3. Check Wrapped event only emits after both transfer and mint succeed
4. Verify any failure reverts entire transaction
5. Ensure no try/catch blocks that could swallow failures

executable_checks.assertion: Wrapped event exists and is emitted at function end
No try/catch that could allow partial execution
Failed mint reverts entire wrap including transfer

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-STATE-WRAP-COMPLETE -> Node STATE-WRAP-COMPLETE. Atomicity guarantee - all or nothing execution.

checklist.title: Verify STATE-LM-AWAITING-UNWRAP validates sufficient zERC20 balance
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Locate unwrap() function entry point
2. Verify balance check occurs via burn() or explicit check
3. Confirm ERC20._burn validates balance >= amount
4. Check for any bypasses around balance validation
5. Verify check happens before any underlying transfer

executable_checks.assertion: Unwrap reverts on insufficient zERC20 balance

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-STATE-LM-AWAITING-UNWRAP -> Node STATE-LM-AWAITING-UNWRAP. Balance validation prevents over-withdrawal.

checklist.title: Verify ACTION-LM-CALCULATE-FEE uses ceiling rounding protecting protocol revenue
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Locate IncentiveLib fee calculation function
2. Verify ceiling rounding is used (not floor)
3. Check immutability of fee parameters
4. Verify calculation is deterministic
5. Test edge cases for fee computation

executable_checks.assertion: Fee calculation with ceiling rounding exists

executable_checks.command: Verify ceiling division in fee computation

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-ACTION-LM-CALCULATE-FEE -> Node ACTION-LM-CALCULATE-FEE. Economic security - ceiling rounding protects protocol revenue.

checklist.title: Verify ACTION-LM-BURN-ZERC20 executes before underlying transfer (burn-first pattern)
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Trace control flow in unwrap() function
2. Verify _burn call precedes safeTransfer call
3. Confirm no code paths allow transfer before burn
4. Check for reentrancy vectors between operations
5. Verify burn failure prevents any underlying release

executable_checks.assertion: Burn occurs before transfer in all code paths
No reentrancy between burn and transfer

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-ACTION-LM-BURN-ZERC20 -> Node ACTION-LM-BURN-ZERC20. Prevents double-withdrawal attacks via burn-first pattern.

checklist.title: Verify ACTION-LM-TRANSFER-UNDERLYING transfers exactly (amount - fee)
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Locate transfer call in unwrap() function
2. Verify transfer amount = (amount - computed_fee)
3. Confirm fee is retained by contract
4. Check no rounding errors in amount computation
5. Verify SafeERC20 is used for transfer
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-ACTION-LM-TRANSFER-UNDERLYING -> Node ACTION-LM-TRANSFER-UNDERLYING. Exact value transfer guarantee.

checklist.title: Verify STATE-UNWRAP-COMPLETE requires atomic burn AND transfer
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Verify unwrap() is a single transaction
2. Confirm both burn and transfer must succeed
3. Check Unwrapped event only emits after both operations
4. Verify any failure reverts entire transaction
5. Ensure no partial state persistence

executable_checks.assertion: Unwrapped event exists at function end
Failed transfer reverts burn as well

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-STATE-UNWRAP-COMPLETE -> Node STATE-UNWRAP-COMPLETE. Atomicity for unwrap - both burn and transfer succeed or both revert.

checklist.title: Verify STATE-UNWRAP-FAILED-INSUFFICIENT-LIQUIDITY prevents unwrap when reserves insufficient
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Locate liquidity check in unwrap/fee calculation
2. Verify amount <= underlyingBalance - feeSurplus check exists
3. Confirm InsufficientLiquidity error is thrown on violation
4. Check no bypasses around liquidity validation
5. Verify check happens before any state changes

executable_checks.assertion: Unwrap reverts when underlying reserves insufficient

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-STATE-UNWRAP-FAILED-INSUFFICIENT-LIQUIDITY -> Node STATE-UNWRAP-FAILED-INSUFFICIENT-LIQUIDITY. Liquidity protection prevents protocol insolvency.

checklist.title: Verify STATE-ZERC20-AWAITING-TRANSFER validates sender balance before transfer
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Locate zERC20 transfer/transferFrom functions
2. Verify OpenZeppelin ERC20._transfer checks balance >= amount
3. Confirm check happens before any state modification
4. Check for any override that bypasses validation
5. Verify standard ERC20 behavior is preserved

executable_checks.assertion: Transfer function with balance check exists

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-STATE-ZERC20-AWAITING-TRANSFER -> Node STATE-ZERC20-AWAITING-TRANSFER. Standard ERC20 balance check enforcement.

checklist.title: Verify ACTION-ZERC20-VALIDATE-VALUE enforces value <= 2^248-1 for BN254 compatibility
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Locate value validation in zERC20 _afterTokenTransfer hook
2. Verify MAX_VALUE constant equals 2^248 - 1
3. Confirm value <= MAX_VALUE check with correct operator
4. Check ValueTooLarge error is thrown on violation
5. Verify all value-modifying operations pass through this check
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-ACTION-ZERC20-VALIDATE-VALUE -> Node ACTION-ZERC20-VALIDATE-VALUE. BN254 scalar field bounds for ZK circuit compatibility.

checklist.title: Verify ACTION-ZERC20-UPDATE-BALANCES performs atomic debit/credit
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Verify EVM transaction atomicity is relied upon
2. Check no external calls between balance updates
3. Confirm standard ERC20 balance update pattern
4. Verify no view functions can observe intermediate state
5. Check for any storage gaps or inconsistencies

executable_checks.assertion: Debit and credit are atomic within transaction

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-ACTION-ZERC20-UPDATE-BALANCES -> Node ACTION-ZERC20-UPDATE-BALANCES. EVM atomicity guarantee for balance updates.

checklist.title: Verify ACTION-ZERC20-UPDATE-HASH-CHAIN computes SHA-256 correctly with 248-bit truncation
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Locate hash chain update logic in _afterTokenTransfer
2. Verify formula: SHA-256(prevHash || to || value) truncated to 248 bits
3. Confirm hash encoding matches Nova circuit implementation
4. Check truncation method (shift vs mask)
5. Verify append-only behavior (no delete or modify)

executable_checks.assertion: SHA-256 used for hash chain (or keccak if specified)
On-chain and off-chain hash computations match

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-ACTION-ZERC20-UPDATE-HASH-CHAIN -> Node ACTION-ZERC20-UPDATE-HASH-CHAIN. SHA-256 collision resistance with 248-bit truncation for Nova compatibility.

checklist.title: Verify ACTION-ZERC20-EMIT-INDEXED-TRANSFER emits monotonically increasing index
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Locate IndexedTransfer event and emission
2. Verify index counter is monotonically increasing
3. Check increment uses unchecked{++index} pattern
4. Confirm no reset or decrement operations exist
5. Verify index survives contract upgrades (if applicable)
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-ACTION-ZERC20-EMIT-INDEXED-TRANSFER -> Node ACTION-ZERC20-EMIT-INDEXED-TRANSFER. Indexer relies on monotonic indices for Merkle tree construction.

checklist.title: Verify STATE-TRANSFER-COMPLETE guarantees atomic balance, hash chain, and event updates
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Verify all three operations in same transaction
2. Check ordering: balance -> hash chain -> event
3. Confirm any failure reverts all three
4. Verify no partial state observable
5. Check Transfer event (ERC20) and IndexedTransfer event consistency

executable_checks.assertion: Balance, hash chain, and event are atomic
All state updates succeed or fail together

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-NODE-STATE-TRANSFER-COMPLETE -> Node STATE-TRANSFER-COMPLETE. Atomic state transition ensures consistency.
